entities.Name: MJ_BizApps_Collaboration :  Item   Uses
entities.Description: A   record   that   a   member   opened ,  uploaded ,  or   promoted   an   item .

Fields.Name: ItemID
Fields.Description: The   space   item   that   was   used .

Fields.Name: UserID
Fields.Description: The   member   who   opened ,  uploaded ,  or   promoted   the   item .

Fields.Name: UsedAt
Fields.Description: When   the   use   happened .

Fields.Name: Kind
Fields.Description: open ,  upload ,  or   promote .

Fields.Name: SpaceID
Fields.Description: The   space   the   use   happened   in .  Required   so   the   read   filter   can   keep   the   row   inside   spaces   the   caller   reaches .

entities.Name: MJ_BizApps_Collaboration :  Share   Notices
entities.Description: A   notice   that   an   item   in   this   space   was   shared   with   a   member .

Fields.Name: SpaceID
Fields.Description: The   space   the   notice   belongs   to .  The   read   filter   keeps   a   caller   inside   spaces   they   reach .

Fields.Name: ItemID
Fields.Description: The   space   item   that   was   shared .

Fields.Name: RecipientUserID
Fields.Description: The   member   the   notice   is   for .

entities.Name: MJ_BizApps_Collaboration :  Space   Anchors
entities.Description: A   record   a   space   is   about  ( D26 :  a   space   may   have   several ).  The   primary   anchor   is   the   one   EnsureSpaceForRecord   finds   a   space   by ;  one   per   space ,  and   one   space   per  ( type ,  record )  as   primary .

Fields.Name: SpaceID
Fields.Description: The   space .

Fields.Name: SpaceTypeID
Fields.Description: The   space ' s   type ,  denormalized   so   the   primary - per - type   index   can   hold ;  the   server   keeps   it   equal   to   the   space ' s   and   rewrites   it   when   the   type   changes .

Fields.Name: EntityID
Fields.Description: The   entity   of   the   anchored   record .

Fields.Name: RecordID
Fields.Description: The   record ' s   key ,  in   the   canonical   shape   SpaceItem . RecordID   uses .

Fields.Name: Role
Fields.Description: What   the   record   is   to   the   space ,  in   the   type ' s   vocabulary :  chapter ,  sponsor ,  event .  Data   reach  ( D28 )  names   an   anchor   by   this   role .

Fields.Name: IsPrimary
Fields.Description: The   one   anchor   a   space   is   found   by .  At   most   one   per   space .

Fields.Name: Sequence
Fields.Description: Display   order   among   the   space ' s   anchors .

Fields.Name: ArchivedOnSpaceClose
Fields.Description: Indicates   whether   this   space   chat   conversation   was   archived   when   its   space   was   closed   so   it   can   be   restored   on   reopen .

entities.Name: MJ_BizApps_Collaboration :  Space   Grants
entities.Description: Something   the   app ,  a   space   type   or   a   space   offers   in   its   spaces  ( D27 ' s   seven   kinds ):  an   agent ,  an   action ,  a   query ,  a   view ,  a   dashboard ,  a   component   or   a   knowledge   source ,  with   the   band   that   may   use   it ,  bindings   from   the   space   to   the   target ' s   parameters ,  and   an   agent ' s   narrowed   settings .  Replaces   SpaceAgent ,  SpaceAgentSkill   and   SpaceKnowledgeSource .

Fields.Name: SpaceTypeID
Fields.Description: The   type   the   grant   belongs   to ;  null   with   SpaceID   null   is   the   app ' s   own   row .

Fields.Name: SpaceID
Fields.Description: The   space   the   grant   belongs   to ;  never   set   together   with   SpaceTypeID .

Fields.Name: Kind
Fields.Description: Agent ,  Action ,  Query ,  View ,  Dashboard ,  Component   or   KnowledgeSource .  TargetEntityID   must   be   the   kind ' s   entity .

Fields.Name: TargetEntityID
Fields.Description: The   target ' s   entity :  MJ :  AI   Agents ,  MJ :  Actions ,  MJ :  Queries ,  MJ :  User   Views ,  MJ :  Dashboards ,  MJ :  Components   or   MJ :  Content   Sources ,  by   Kind .

Fields.Name: TargetRecordID
Fields.Description: The   target   record ' s   key .

Fields.Name: Label
Fields.Description: What   the   space   calls   the   target ;  null   uses   the   target ' s   own   name .

Fields.Name: Band
Fields.Description: The   band   that   may   use   the   grant  ( D31 ).  A   Team   grant   is   not   offered   in   a   chat   where   anyone   cannot   see   Team .

Fields.Name: IsDefault
Fields.Description: For   an   Agent   grant :  the   agent   a   chat   at   this   level   starts   with .  One   per   level .

Fields.Name: Bindings
Fields.Description: JSON  ( SpaceGrantBindings ):  the   target ' s   parameter   or   property   names   mapped   to   where   each   value   comes   from :  an   anchor   by   role ,  a   column   of   the   space ,  a   configuration   key ,  the   user ,  or   a   literal  ( D27 ).

Fields.Name: Settings
Fields.Description: JSON  ( AgentGrantSettings )  for   an   Agent   grant :  skills ,  plan   mode ,  effort ,  memory   writes   and   per - run   limits ,  each   only   narrowing   the   agent ' s   own   definition  ( D31 ).  Null   for   the   other   kinds .

Fields.Name: Mode
Fields.Description: Extend   adds   the   target   at   this   level ;  Remove   takes   a   target   granted   above   out   of   this   level ' s   list  ( D30 ).

Fields.Name: Sequence
Fields.Description: Display   order   within   the   level .

entities.Name: MJ_BizApps_Collaboration :  Space   Items
entities.Description: An   item   in   exactly   one   space :  EntityID  +  RecordID ,  plus   Team   or   Shared .  Unique   on  ( EntityID ,  RecordID )  so   an   item   cannot   have   two   parents .

Fields.Name: EntityID
Fields.Description: The   entity   the   item   points   at .  Same   polymorphic   pair   TaskLink   uses .

Fields.Name: RecordID
Fields.Description: Primary   key   of   the   pointed - at   record ,  as   text ,  matching   TaskLink . RecordID .

Fields.Name: Band
Fields.Description: Team  ( working   material ,  not   in   the   client - facing   agent   scope )  or   Shared  ( promoted ,  with   an   actor   and   a   timestamp ).

Fields.Name: PromotedAt
Fields.Description: When   a   Shared   item   was   promoted .  Null   on   Team   items .

Fields.Name: PromotedByUserID
Fields.Description: MJ   user   who   promoted   a   Shared   item .  Required   together   with   PromotedAt .  Null   on   Team   items .

Fields.Name: Folder
Fields.Description: Folder   label   inside   the   space .  Null   means   Unfiled .  Collections   cannot   say   everyone   in   the   space ,  so   the   folder   lives   on   the   item .

Fields.Name: ArtifactVersionID
Fields.Description: For   a   document   in   the   Library :  the   MJ   Artifact   Version  ( ContentMode   File )  wrapping   the   MJ :  Files   row   the   item   points   at ,  so   the   document   has   a   type ,  a   viewer   and   versions .  NULL   for   items   that   are   not   files .  Artifact   Permissions   are   not   used   by   the   Library ;  the   roster   is   the   one   sharing   model .

entities.Name: MJ_BizApps_Collaboration :  Space   Member   Pins
entities.Description: Something   a   member   keeps   at   the   top   of   a   space  ( B22 ):  a   record   of   the   space  ( an   item ,  a   note ,  a   task )  or   one   of   the   space ' s   grants  ( a   view ,  a   dashboard ,  a   component ).  The   member ' s   own ;  Home   lists   pins   from   the   spaces   they   still   reach .

Fields.Name: SpaceID
Fields.Description: The   space   the   pin   is   in .

Fields.Name: UserID
Fields.Description: Whose   pin   it   is :  the   caller .

Fields.Name: Kind
Fields.Description: Record :  a   record   of   the   space   by   entity   and   key .  Grant :  one   of   the   space ' s   grants .

Fields.Name: TargetEntityID
Fields.Description: For   a   Record   pin :  the   record ' s   entity .

Fields.Name: TargetRecordID
Fields.Description: For   a   Record   pin :  the   record ' s   key .

Fields.Name: GrantID
Fields.Description: For   a   Grant   pin :  the   grant   in   force   for   the   member ' s   space   and   band .

Fields.Name: Sequence
Fields.Description: The   member ' s   order   of   pins .

entities.Name: MJ_BizApps_Collaboration :  Space   Members
entities.Description: One   roster   row   per   user   per   space .  Staff   and   outsiders   are   both   MJ   users .  Status   Active   is   the   row   the   membership   filter   accepts .

Fields.Name: Band
Fields.Description: Team   or   Shared .  Set   by   the   server   from   the   role :  CanSeeTeamBand   seats   the   person   on   Team ,  otherwise   Shared .  The   filter   reads   the   role ,  not   this   column .

Fields.Name: Status
Fields.Description: Invited ,  Active ,  or   Removed .  New   rows   start   Invited   unless   the   type   auto - approves .

entities.Name: MJ_BizApps_Collaboration :  Space   Notes
entities.Description: A   light   note   in   a   space  ( B21 ):  the   space ' s   own   row   on   a   band ,  not   a   library   item ,  so   the   move - and - promote   rules   do   not   apply   and   it   needs   no   ItemUse .  Private   notes   are   the   author ' s   alone .

Fields.Name: SpaceID
Fields.Description: The   space   the   note   belongs   to .

Fields.Name: Title
Fields.Description: The   note ' s   title .

Fields.Name: Body
Fields.Description: The   note ' s   body ,  Markdown .

Fields.Name: Band
Fields.Description: Team   or   Shared :  who   in   the   space   may   read   it .  A   Team   note   moves   to   Shared   only   when   the   plan ' s   call   15   allows   it .

Fields.Name: Visibility
Fields.Description: Space :  the   band   reads   it .  Private :  the   author   alone ,  and   then   the   band   is   Team .

Fields.Name: AuthorUserID
Fields.Description: Who   wrote   the   note :  the   caller   on   create ,  and   the   only   one   who   edits   or   deletes   it .

entities.Name: MJ_BizApps_Collaboration :  Space   Role   Types
entities.Description: What   a   space   member   is   allowed   to   do .  The   engine   reads   Level   and   the   BIT   flags .  It   never   compares   Code   or   Name .

Fields.Name: Level
Fields.Description: This   role ' s   own   authority .  A   grant   must   be   of   a   role   whose   Level   is  <=  the   grantor ' s   MaxGrantableLevel .

Fields.Name: MaxGrantableLevel
Fields.Description: Highest   Level   this   role   may   grant .  Always  <=  Level .

Fields.Name: CanInvite
Fields.Description: Holder   may   invite   members   into   a   space   they   belong   to ,  inside   their   own   subtree ,  at   or   below   MaxGrantableLevel .

Fields.Name: CanPromoteBand
Fields.Description: Holder   may   move   an   item   from   Team   to   Shared .

Fields.Name: CanSeeTeamBand
Fields.Description: Holder   may   read   Team - band   items .  Shared - band   items   do   not   need   this   flag .

Fields.Name: IsOwnerRole
Fields.Description: The   role   that   defines   ownership   of   a   space .  The   engine   reads   the   flag ,  not   the   name .

Fields.Name: CanContribute
Fields.Description: 1   if   the   role   may   contribute   content  ( create ,  update ,  or   post   items ,  tasks ,  and   messages );  0   for   read - only   roles .

entities.Name: MJ_BizApps_Collaboration :  Space   Type   Status
entities.Description: A   status   a   space   type   offers   its   spaces :  Active ,  Paused ,  Closed   and   Archived   ship   for   every   type ;  a   type   may   add   its   own .  A   space   is   in   exactly   one   of   its   type ' s   statuses  ( Space . StatusID )  and   may   only   choose   among   them .  The   attributes   say   what   a   space   in   the   status   allows ;  the   type ' s   driver   may   still   refuse   a   change .

Fields.Name: SpaceTypeID
Fields.Description: The   type   this   status   belongs   to .

Fields.Name: Code
Fields.Description: The   status ' s   key   within   its   type :  active ,  paused ,  closed ,  archived ,  or   a   type ' s   own .

Fields.Name: Name
Fields.Description: What   the   status   is   called   on   screen .

Fields.Name: Sequence
Fields.Description: The   definitive   order   of   the   type ' s   statuses ,  for   display   and   for   the   rule   that   a   terminal   status   may   only   move   forward .

Fields.Name: IsDefault
Fields.Description: The   status   a   new   space   of   the   type   starts   in ;  one   per   type .

Fields.Name: ReadOnly
Fields.Description: Members   may   read   but   not   post ,  upload ,  assign   or   edit   while   the   space   is   in   this   status .

Fields.Name: Visible
Fields.Description: The   space   is   listed   and   reachable   by   its   members ;  off   hides   it   from   everyone   but   its   owner   and   staff .

Fields.Name: AgentRetrieval
Fields.Description: An   agent   may   quote   the   space ' s   material   while   it   is   in   this   status .

Fields.Name: CanChangeAfter
Fields.Description: Once   a   space   reaches   this   status   it   may   still   move   to   another ;  off   freezes   it   there .  A   frozen   status   must   be   terminal .

Fields.Name: NotifyMembersOnEnter
Fields.Description: Entering   this   status   sends   the   space ' s  " status   changed "  notice ,  one   per   member ,  through   MJ ' s   notification   chain .

Fields.Name: IsTerminal
Fields.Description: Entering   this   status   stamps   Space . ClosedAt ;  retention   and   the   closed   views   count   from   it .  From   a   terminal   status   a   space   may   move   only   to   a   higher   Sequence ,  never   back   to   an   open   one .

entities.Name: MJ_BizApps_Collaboration :  Space   Types
entities.Description: Kind   of   space :  vocabulary ,  which   panels   are   on ,  retention   and   agent   defaults ,  and   how   outsiders   join .  Behavior   lives   in   these   columns ,  not   in   code   branched   on   the   name .

Fields.Name: Code
Fields.Description: Stable   metadata   key .  The   engine   does   not   branch   on   it .

Fields.Name: Name
Fields.Description: Display   name   of   the   type .

Fields.Name: Vocabulary
Fields.Description: Human   noun   for   spaces   of   this   type  ( workspace ,  committee ,  cohort ,  community ).  Open   set .

Fields.Name: Discoverability
Fields.Description: Hidden ,  Listed ,  or   Open .  Modelled   now ;  the   community   surface   that   uses   Listed   and   Open   is   a   later   release .

Fields.Name: JoinMode
Fields.Description: InviteOnly ,  RequestToJoin ,  or   SelfServe .

Fields.Name: MessagingPanel
Fields.Description: Conversation   panel   is   on   for   spaces   of   this   type .

Fields.Name: LibraryPanel
Fields.Description: File   library   panel   is   on .

Fields.Name: WorkPanel
Fields.Description: Task  /  work   panel   is   on .

Fields.Name: DefaultAgentRetrieval
Fields.Description: Default   AgentRetrieval   for   a   new   space   of   this   type .

Fields.Name: DefaultBand
Fields.Description: Default   Team   or   Shared   band   for   a   new   item   in   a   space   of   this   type .

Fields.Name: InviteApproval
Fields.Description: Approve :  a   new   member   stays   Invited   until   an   owner   of   the   space   sets   them   Active .  AutoApprove :  the   server   creates   the   member   Active .  The   invited   person   does   not   activate   themselves .

Fields.Name: MemberCap
Fields.Description: Maximum   members   in   one   space   of   this   type .  Null   means   no   cap .

Fields.Name: DefaultAllowParentAssignees
Fields.Description: Default   AllowParentAssignees   setting   for   new   spaces   of   this   type .

Fields.Name: IconClass
Fields.Description: Font   Awesome   icon   class   representing   the   space   type  ( e . g .,  fa - solid   fa - compass ).

Fields.Name: Color
Fields.Description: Hex   color   code   representing   the   space   type  ( e . g ., # 0076b6 ).

entities.Name: MJ_BizApps_Collaboration :  Spaces
entities.Description: The   container .  Permission   boundary   and   agent   retrieval   boundary ,  as   a   tree :  one   root   per   relationship ,  sub - spaces   for   the   work   inside   it .

Fields.Name: ParentID
Fields.Description: Parent   space .  Null   on   a   root .  It   does   not   carry   the   IsHierarchy   flag ,  so   CodeGen   emits   no   path   columns .

Fields.Name: Name
Fields.Description: Designated   name   of   the   space .

Fields.Name: OwnerID
Fields.Description: MJ   user   who   owns   the   space .

Fields.Name: InheritsMembership
Fields.Description: 1 :  members   of   this   space   are   members   of   its   descendants .  0 :  this   sub - space   keeps   its   own   roster .

Fields.Name: AgentRetrieval
Fields.Description: Included ,  ExcludedFromParentScope ,  or   ExcludedEntirely .  A   human   may   read   a   space   that   no   agent   may   quote .

Fields.Name: StartedAt
Fields.Description: When   this   space  ( usually   a   sub - space )  started .  The   root   outlives   its   children .

Fields.Name: ClosedAt
Fields.Description: When   this   space   closed .  Closure   is   a   timestamp   on   the   sub - space ,  not   a   delete   of   the   root .

Fields.Name: AllowParentAssignees
Fields.Description: 1   if   participants   in   this   space   may   assign   people   seated   on   ancestor   spaces   whose   membership   reaches   this   space ;  0   to   restrict   assignment   to   seats   in   this   space   or   below .  Only   staff   may   change   this   switch .

Fields.Name: PlannedCloseAt
Fields.Description: Target   or   planned   close   date / time   for   the   space .  Actual   closure   is   recorded   in   ClosedAt .

Fields.Name: IconClass
Fields.Description: Font   Awesome   icon   class   representing   the   space  ( e . g .,  fa - solid   fa - folder - tree ,  fa - solid   fa - briefcase ).  Overrides   SpaceType . IconClass   if   set .

Fields.Name: Color
Fields.Description: Hex   color   code   representing   the   space  ( e . g ., # 0076b6 , # 10b981 ).  Overrides   SpaceType . Color   if   set .

Fields.Name: BackgroundImageURL
Fields.Description: URL   of   an   optional   hero   banner   or   background   image   displayed   in   the   space   header   and   overview .

Fields.Name: StatusID
Fields.Description: The   status   the   space   is   in ,  one   of   its   type ' s  ( SpaceTypeStatus ).  NULL   until   the   server   stamps   it :  then   the   type ' s   default   while   ClosedAt   is   null ,  and   the   type ' s   first   terminal   status   once   ClosedAt   is   set ,  as   fnCollaborationSpaceStatuses   derives   it .

entities.Name: MJ_BizApps_Common :  Activities
entities.Description: One   interaction   that   happened   between   people ,  about   records .  Timeline   card  —  not   a   blob   store ,  not   a   task ,  not   field - level   audit .  Duration   is   derived   from   StartedAt / EndedAt .

Fields.Name: StartedAt
Fields.Description: Sort   key   for   every   timeline .  Instant   events   use   the   date / time   of   the   event .

Fields.Name: EndedAt
Fields.Description: End   of   a   meeting / call .  Leave   null   for   a   point - in - time   log .  Must   be  >=  StartedAt   when   set .  Duration   is   derived ;  do   not   store   it .

Fields.Name: Title
Fields.Description: Subject  /  one - line   card   title  ( e . g .  Called   Jane   about   renewal ).

Fields.Name: Description
Fields.Description: Notes   or   a   short   excerpt .  Not   the   full   email   body  —  that   lives   on   an   ActivityFile   of   Kind   Body .

Fields.Name: Direction
Fields.Description: Inbound ,  Outbound ,  or   Internal .  Channel   lives   on   ActivityType ;  direction   lives   here   so   inbound   email   is   a   filter ,  not   a   type   explosion .

Fields.Name: Status
Fields.Description: Logged  ( default   for   a   past   event ),  Scheduled ,  Completed ,  Cancelled ,  or   Failed .

Fields.Name: Outcome
Fields.Description: Optional   disposition :  Connected ,  LeftVoicemail ,  NoAnswer ,  NoShow ,  Bounced ,  Interested ,  NotInterested .  A   filter ,  not   a   type .

Fields.Name: Visibility
Fields.Description: Internal  ( anyone   who   can   read   a   Regarding   record )  or   Private  ( LoggedByUserID   only ,  until   a   PermissionEngine   domain   exists ).  Manual   default   is   Internal ;  synced   mail   should   default   Private   in   the   engine .

Fields.Name: Source
Fields.Description: How   the   row   was   written :  Manual ,  System ,  or   Integration .

Fields.Name: SourceSystem
Fields.Description: Provider   name   for   idempotent   sync  ( Microsoft365 ,  Gmail ,  Zoom ).  Required   when   ExternalID   is   set .

Fields.Name: ExternalID
Fields.Description: Provider   message / event   id .  Unique   with   SourceSystem   where   set  —  never   dedup   by   subject .

Fields.Name: ExternalThreadID
Fields.Description: Email   or   calendar   thread   id   used   to   group   replies .

Fields.Name: Location
Fields.Description: Meeting   place   as   text .  Optional   AddressID   is   the   structured   location .

Fields.Name: Details
Fields.Description: JSON   extras   that   are   not   query   predicates :  MessageID ,  InReplyTo ,  MeetingURL ,  Mailbox ,  Folder ,  CalendarEventID .  See   ActivityDetails .

Fields.Name: SentimentScore
Fields.Description: Derived   sentiment   score   for   this   activity ,  bounded   between  - 1 . 000  ( most   negative )  and  + 1 . 000  ( most   positive ).  Populated   by   the   Activity   Tagging   and   Sentiment   feature   pipeline .

entities.Name: MJ_BizApps_Common :  Activity   Files
entities.Description: Join   from   an   Activity   to   an   MJ   File .  Kind   Body   is   the   full   MIME / HTML  ( at   most   one   per   activity );  Attachment   and   Ics   are   extras .  Deleting   the   activity   drops   the   join ,  not   the   File .

Fields.Name: Kind
Fields.Description: Body  ( full   MIME / HTML ,  at   most   one   per   activity ),  Attachment ,  or   Ics .

Fields.Name: Sequence
Fields.Description: Display   order   of   attachments .

entities.Name: MJ_BizApps_Common :  Activity   Links
entities.Description: Attaches   an   Activity   to   a   resolved   MJ   record  ( EntityID  +  RecordID )  or   an   unresolved   identity  ( email / phone / external   user )  the   matcher   has   not   stamped   yet .  Role   says   whether   the   link   is   Regarding ,  a   participant ,  or   an   email / meeting   mailbox   role .

Fields.Name: Role
Fields.Description: Why   this   record   is   on   the   activity :  Regarding  ( what   it   is   about ),  Participant ,  From / To / Cc / Bcc ,  Organizer / Attendee ,  or   LoggedFor  ( the   mailbox   it   was   filed   under ).

Fields.Name: RecordID
Fields.Description: Primary   key   of   the   resolved   record .  NVARCHAR   so   composite   keys   work .  Required   with   EntityID ;  must   be   null   when   the   link   is   an   unresolved   identity .

Fields.Name: IdentityKind
Fields.Description: Email ,  Phone ,  or   ExternalUser .  Set   with   IdentityValue   when   the   participant   has   not   been   matched   to   a   Person / Org   yet .

Fields.Name: IdentityValue
Fields.Description: The   unmatched   address ,  phone ,  or   provider   user   id .  A   later   matcher   stamps   EntityID / RecordID   from   ContactMethod . Value   and   clears   these .

Fields.Name: Sequence
Fields.Description: Display   order   within   a   role  ( To ,  then   Cc , …).

entities.Name: MJ_BizApps_Common :  Activity   Sync   Connection   Rule   Sets
entities.Description: Binds   a   rule   set   to   a   connection ,  ordered .  Many - to - many   so   a   mailbox   composes   an   org - wide   baseline ,  a   team   overlay ,  and   anything   specific   to   itself  —  rather   than   owning   one   private   copy   of   everything .

Fields.Name: ActivitySyncRuleSetID
Fields.Description: The   rule   set   bound   to   this   connection .  A   mailbox   composes   several   sets  ( org   baseline ,  team   overlay ,  mailbox - specific )  through   this   join ;  Sequence   on   the   binding   is   the   evaluation   order .

entities.Name: MJ_BizApps_Common :  Activity   Sync   Connections
entities.Description: A   mailbox ,  calendar ,  or   other   provider   connection   that   writes   Activities .  CredentialsRef   is   an   MJ   Credentials   engine   key  —  never   a   secret   at   rest .

Fields.Name: Name
Fields.Description: Display   name   of   the   connection  ( e . g .  Amith  /  Microsoft   365 ).

Fields.Name: Provider
Fields.Description: DEPRECATED  —  use   ActivitySyncProviderTypeID .  Retained   nullable   so   a   published   host   keeps   working ;  removed   in   the   next   major .

Fields.Name: Status
Fields.Description: Active ,  Paused ,  Error ,  or   Disabled .

Fields.Name: Direction
Fields.Description: Inbound  ( pull   into   CRM ),  Outbound ,  or   Bidirectional .

Fields.Name: CredentialsRef
Fields.Description: MJ   Credentials   engine   key .  NEVER   a   secret   value   at   rest .

Fields.Name: Mailbox
Fields.Description: Mailbox   address   this   connection   reads  ( jane @ acme . com ).

Fields.Name: LastSyncAt
Fields.Description: When   the   engine   last   completed   a   sync   for   this   connection .

Fields.Name: LastError
Fields.Description: Most   recent   sync   error ,  if   Status   is   Error .

Fields.Name: Settings
Fields.Description: JSON   provider   extras  ( TenantID ,  MailboxFolder ,  CalendarID ,  IncludeCalendar ,  IncludeMail ).  See   ActivitySyncConnectionSettings .

Fields.Name: ActivitySyncProviderTypeID
Fields.Description: The   provider   type   this   connection   reads .  Supersedes   the   Provider   string   column ,  whose   CHECK   constraint   made   every   new   source   a   migration   to   Common .

Fields.Name: StartAt
Fields.Description: Activation   window .  Combines   with   Status :  a   connection   syncs   only   when   Status  =  Active   AND   now   is   within  [ StartAt ,  EndAt ],  treating   either   bound   as   open   when   null .  Lets   a   mailbox   be   provisioned   ahead   of   time ,  or   retired   on   a   date ,  without   anyone   remembering   to   flip   a   switch .

Fields.Name: EndAt
Fields.Description: End   of   the   activation   window ;  see   StartAt .  Null   means   open - ended .

Fields.Name: SkippedContentPolicy
Fields.Description: Per - connection   override   of   the   provider   type ' s   DefaultSkippedContentPolicy .  Null   inherits .  This   is   the   knob   for  " this   one   mailbox   is   sensitive "  without   changing   the   estate .

entities.Name: MJ_BizApps_Common :  Activity   Sync   Exclusions
entities.Description: Never - ingest   list ,  by   identity :  an   email   address ,  a   phone   number ,  a   social   handle ,  or   a   whole   domain .  Rows   rather   than   a   delimited   string   because   an   exclusion   that   cannot   be   queried   cannot   be   audited ,  and   this   is   precisely   what   a   legal   hold ,  an   HR   matter   or   an   opt - out   has   to   be   able   to   prove .  Scoped   to   a   rule   set ,  or   global   when   ActivitySyncRuleSetID   is   null .

Fields.Name: ActivitySyncRuleSetID
Fields.Description: Optional   rule   set   this   exclusion   belongs   to .  Null   means   global  —  the   identity   is   never   ingested   on   any   connection .  A   legal   hold   or   opt - out   is   usually   global ;  a   mailbox - specific   mute   is   not .

Fields.Name: PersonID
Fields.Description: Optional   link   to   the   Person   this   identity   belongs   to .  Optional   because   an   address   is   often   excluded   before   anyone   knows   whose   it   is ,  and   because   a   Person   has   several   ContactMethods  —  the   identity   is   the   durable   key   here ,  not   the   record .

Fields.Name: EffectiveFrom
Fields.Description: Start   of   the   window   of   MESSAGES   this   exclusion   covers ,  matched   against   the   item ' s   own   time  --  when   a   message   was   sent   or   received ,  or   when   a   meeting   starts  --  NOT   against   the   current   time .  Leave   empty   for   no   lower   bound .  This   is   deliberately   different   from   ActivitySyncConnection . StartAt ,  which   is   evaluated   against   the   clock :  setting   this   to   today   does   not   mean  " exclude   from   today   onwards ",  it   means  " exclude   messages   dated   today   or   later ",  so   a   later   backfill   of   older   mail   is   not   covered   by   it .  Item   time   is   also   what   keeps   a   re - run   reproducible ,  so   the   run   log   can   answer   which   rule   excluded   a   message   and   give   the   same   answer   next   time .

Fields.Name: EffectiveTo
Fields.Description: End   of   the   window   of   MESSAGES   this   exclusion   covers ,  matched   against   the   item ' s   own   time  --  when   a   message   was   sent   or   received ,  or   when   a   meeting   starts  --  NOT   against   the   current   time .  Leave   empty   for   no   upper   bound .  Inclusive   of   the   instant   given ,  matching   how   ActivitySyncRule   DateFrom / DateTo   compare .  See   EffectiveFrom   for   why   this   is   item   time   rather   than   clock   time .

Fields.Name: IsEnabled
Fields.Description: Whether   this   exclusion   is   in   force .  Unchecked ,  it   is   ignored   entirely   and   the   messages   it   names   are   qualified   as   if   it   did   not   exist .

entities.Name: MJ_BizApps_Common :  Activity   Sync   Extensions
entities.Description: Registration   of   an   in - process   enrichment   plugin   that   runs   inside   the   Activity   write   transaction .  Common   ships   this   table ;  each   consumer   app   ships   its   own   rows ,  so   a   downstream   app   adds   links  ( a   deal ,  a   campaign )  without   Common   knowing   it   exists .  Extensions   ENRICH  —  they   never   veto   an   activity ,  because   qualification   has   already   run   and   capture   must   not   depend   on   which   apps   are   installed .

Fields.Name: ActivitySyncProviderTypeID
Fields.Description: Optional   provider   type   this   extension   is   registered   for .  Null   means   it   runs   on   every   connection .  A   deal - linker   that   only   makes   sense   on   email   can   bind   here   rather   than   being   invoked   for   a   phone   transcript .

Fields.Name: Sequence
Fields.Description: Ascending   run   order .  REQUIRED   rather   than   incidental :  two   extensions   both   adding   links   must   not   depend   on   registration   order ,  which   varies   with   package   load   order   and   is   not   reproducible .

Fields.Name: FailurePolicy
Fields.Description: What   happens   when   this   extension   throws .  Skip  ( the   default )  records   the   error   and   commits   the   activity   without   the   enrichment ;  Abort   rolls   the   whole   write   back .  Skip   is   the   default   because   the   activity   is   worth   more   than   the   enrichment ,  and   one   buggy   consumer   app   must   not   be   able   to   halt   ingestion   for   every   other   app   on   the   host .

entities.Name: MJ_BizApps_Common :  Activity   Sync   Provider   Types
entities.Description: A   kind   of   activity   source  ( Microsoft365 ,  Gmail ,  Twilio   SMS ,  LinkedIn , …).  Provider   identity   is   DATA ,  not   a   CHECK   constraint ,  so   a   new   source   is   a   new   plugin   package   plus   a   metadata   row  —  never   a   migration   to   Common .  Also   carries   the   DEFAULTS   an   operator   should   set   once   per   provider   rather   than   per   mailbox :  storage ,  encryption   key ,  attachment   cap ,  and   what   an   undecided   qualification   verdict   means .

Fields.Name: DefaultQualificationPolicy
Fields.Description: What   an   Undecided   qualification   verdict   means   for   this   provider   once   every   rule   stage   has   abstained .  Exclude  ( the   default )  fails   CLOSED  —  correct   for   anything   mailbox - shaped ,  where   capturing   a   private   message   is   worse   than   missing   a   business   one .

Fields.Name: DefaultSkippedContentPolicy
Fields.Description: Whether   a   SKIPPED   message   may   have   content   retained   for   audit ,  and   how   much .  None   keeps   only   the   opaque   external   id   and   the   decision .  SubjectEncrypted   and   FullEncrypted   additionally   keep   ciphertext ,  and   are   only   valid   with   DefaultEncryptionKeyID   set  —  enforced   by   CK_ActivitySyncProviderType_KeyRequired .  Overridable   per   connection .

Fields.Name: IsActive
Fields.Description: Whether   this   connector   type   may   run .  Unchecked ,  every   connection   using   it   refuses   on   its   next   fleet   tick   and   reports   Status  =  Error   with   the   reason ,  rather   than   appearing   to   sync  --  and   each   returns   to   Active   by   itself   once   the   type   is   re - enabled   and   a   run   succeeds .  Nothing   is   read   from   any   mailbox   while   it   is   off .

entities.Name: MJ_BizApps_Common :  Activity   Sync   Rule   Sets
entities.Description: A   NAMED ,  REUSABLE   set   of   rules   bound   to   many   connections .  Rules   used   to   hang   off   a   single   connection ,  so   an   org - wide   prohibition   had   to   be   retyped   for   every   mailbox   and   a   new   mailbox   started   with   none  —  governance   by   copy - paste .  A   rule   set   is   authored   once   and   bound   wherever   it   applies .

Fields.Name: ActivitySyncProviderTypeID
Fields.Description: Optional   provider   type   this   rule   set   is   written   for .  Null   means   the   set   applies   regardless   of   source  —  an   org - wide   prohibition   does   not   care   whether   the   mailbox   is   Microsoft365   or   Gmail .

Fields.Name: InternalDomains
Fields.Description: JSON   array   of   the   domains   this   deployment   considers   INTERNAL ,  e . g . [" bluecypress . io "].  Required   for   any   rule   using   ParticipantScope : " internal "  is   a   property   of   the   deployment ,  not   of   a   message .  Held   on   the   rule   set   so   one   definition   serves   every   mailbox   bound   to   it .

entities.Name: MJ_BizApps_Common :  Activity   Sync   Rules
entities.Description: Include / exclude   rule   for   an   ActivitySyncConnection :  type ,  direction ,  date   window ,  attachments ,  plus   a   JSON   Filter  ( folders ,  domains ,  participant - must - match - ContactMethod ).

Fields.Name: Name
Fields.Description: Display   name   of   the   rule .

Fields.Name: IsEnabled
Fields.Description: 0   skips   the   rule   without   deleting   it .

Fields.Name: Sequence
Fields.Description: Evaluation   order   within   the   connection .  Lower   first .

Fields.Name: Action
Fields.Description: Include   or   Exclude   matching   items .  With   no   rules ,  the   engine   syncs   everything   the   connection   can   see .

Fields.Name: Direction
Fields.Description: Optional   direction   filter  ( Inbound  /  Outbound  /  Internal ).  Null  =  any .

Fields.Name: DateFrom
Fields.Description: Inclusive   lower   bound   of   the   sync   window .  Null  =  no   lower   bound .

Fields.Name: DateTo
Fields.Description: Inclusive   upper   bound   of   the   sync   window .  Null  =  no   upper   bound .

Fields.Name: IncludeAttachments
Fields.Description: 1  =  also   pull   attachments   into   ActivityFile   rows .

Fields.Name: Filter
Fields.Description: JSON   match   extras :  Folders ,  ExcludeFolders ,  Domains ,  ExcludeDomains ,  ParticipantMustMatchContactMethod ,  SubjectContains ,  SubjectExcludes .  See   ActivitySyncRuleFilter .

Fields.Name: ActivitySyncRuleSetID
Fields.Description: The   rule   set   this   rule   belongs   to .  Exactly   one   of   ActivitySyncRuleSetID   and   ActivitySyncConnectionID   is   set  ( CK_ActivitySyncRule_Owner ) —  the   connection   form   is   the   deprecated   original   and   remains   only   so   existing   rows   stay   valid .

Fields.Name: ParticipantScope
Fields.Description: Which   participants   must   be   present   for   this   rule   to   apply  —  the   internal / external   control .  AllInternal   excludes   purely   internal   chatter ;  HasExternal   catches   a   thread   with   any   outside   party   on   it ;  Mixed   is   the   case   an   all - or - nothing   rule   gets   wrong .  Requires   the   rule   set   to   define   InternalDomains .  Null   means   the   rule   does   not   test   participants .

entities.Name: MJ_BizApps_Common :  Activity   Sync   Run   Details
entities.Description: The   decision   made   about   ONE   message ,  written   for   every   item   considered   INCLUDING   every   skip  —  which   is   what   makes  " why   did   my   email   not   appear "  answerable .  ExternalID   and   the   decision   are   always   safe   to   keep :  an   opaque   provider   id   and   the   name   of   a   rule ,  not   content .  CapturedContent   is   different   in   kind   and   is   governed   by   the   effective   SkippedContentPolicy .  Give   this   entity   permissions   DISTINCT   from   Activity :  it   can   hold   fragments   of   messages   that   were   deliberately   not   ingested .

Fields.Name: DecidedByStage
Fields.Description: Which   stage   of   the   qualification   cascade   decided  —  a   rule   set   name ,  KnownParticipant ,  Inference ,  or   DefaultPolicy .  Paired   with   Reason   it   explains   an   outcome   without   retaining   the   message   that   produced   it .

Fields.Name: AIPromptRunID
Fields.Description: The   MJ :  AI   Prompt   Run   behind   an   inference - stage   verdict .  Non - null   only   when   a   model   actually   decided   this   item ,  which   is   the   audit   trail   for   every   automated   judgement   the   engine   makes .

Fields.Name: CapturedContent
Fields.Description: Ciphertext ,  always  —  never   plaintext ,  whatever   the   policy .  Present   only   when   the   effective   SkippedContentPolicy   allows   retention ,  and   always   paired   with   the   EncryptionKeyID   that   opens   it  ( CK_ActivitySyncRunDetail_ContentKey ).  Encrypted   through   MJ ' s   EncryptionEngine   against   an   MJ :  Encryption   Keys   row ;  this   app   never   implements   its   own   crypto .  ROTATING   THAT   KEY   MAKES   EXISTING   ROWS   UNREADABLE :  rotation   re - encrypts   only   fields   declared   with   Encrypt  =  1 ,  this   column   is   encrypted   by   calling   the   engine   directly ,  and   the   stored   value   records   which   key   opened   it   but   not   which   version  —  so   a   rotation   skips   these   rows   silently   and   the   next   read   of   them   fails .  Retain   content   here   only   for   as   long   as   the   key   behind   it   will   not   be   rotated ,  or   rotate   with   a   plan   for   this   column .  Tracked   upstream   as   MemberJunction / MJ # 4580 .

Fields.Description: Human - readable   outcome   label  ( e . g .  Approved ,  Rejected ,  Approved   With   Conditions ).

Fields.Name: Code
Fields.Description: Stable   machine   code   for   the   outcome ,  used   by   orchestration   code   to   map   outcome   to   task   status  ( e . g .  Approved ,  Rejected ,  ApprovedWithConditions ).

Fields.Name: Sequence
Fields.Description: Display   ordering   for   the   outcome   in   decision   pickers .

Fields.Name: IsTerminal
Fields.Description: When   1 ,  recording   this   outcome   closes   the   approval  ( terminal ).  When   0 ,  the   decision   is   interim   and   the   task   remains   open .

Fields.Name: IsActive
Fields.Description: When   0 ,  the   outcome   is   hidden   from   new   decision   pickers   but   preserved   on   historical   decisions .

Fields.Name: TaskID
Fields.Description: The   task   this   decision   was   recorded   against .

Fields.Name: OutcomeID
Fields.Description: The   decision   outcome  ( FK   to   TaskDecisionOutcome ).

Fields.Name: DecidedByPersonID
Fields.Description: The   Person   who   made   the   decision .

Fields.Name: DecidedAt
Fields.Description: When   the   decision   was   recorded .

Fields.Name: DecisionNotes
Fields.Description: Free - text   rationale   or   conditions   attached   to   the   decision .

Fields.Name: TaskAssignmentID
Fields.Description: Optional   link   to   the   specific   TaskAssignment   this   decision   belongs   to ,  for   per - assignee   decisions   in   multi - approver   flows .  Null   for   a   task - level   decision .

entities.Name: MJ_BizApps_Tasks :  Task   Type   Status
entities.Description: Dynamic   domain   statuses   and   lifecycle   stages   configured   per   Task   Type .

Fields.Name: TaskTypeID
Fields.Description: The   Task   Type   this   status   belongs   to .

Fields.Name: Name
Fields.Description: Display   name   of   the   status  ( e . g .  Legal   Review ,  Redlining ,  Pending   Signature ).

Fields.Name: Code
Fields.Description: Stable   machine   code   for   this   status   within   its   Task   Type  ( e . g .  LEGAL_REVIEW ,  REDLINING ).

Fields.Name: MacroStatus
Fields.Description: The   standard   macro - lifecycle   state   this   domain   status   maps   to  ( Open ,  InProgress ,  Blocked ,  Completed ,  Cancelled ).  Ensures   progress   rollup   and   Gantt   calculations   remain   consistent .

Fields.Name: Sequence
Fields.Description: Ordering   sequence   for   pickers ,  stage   progression   bars ,  and   Kanban   columns .

Fields.Name: IsDefault
Fields.Description: Whether   this   is   the   initial   default   status   when   a   task   of   this   type   is   created .

Fields.Name: IsTerminal
Fields.Description: Whether   this   status   represents   a   closed   terminal   state   for   the   task .

Fields.Name: OnEnterActionID
Fields.Description: Action   invoked   when   a   task   enters   this   specific   status .

Fields.Name: OnExitActionID
Fields.Description: Action   invoked   when   a   task   leaves   this   specific   status .

Fields.Name: OnRejectActionID
Fields.Description: Action   invoked   when   a   task   of   this   type   transitions   to   a   rejected   decision  ( post - commit ,  non - blocking ).  Used   by   approval   workflows .

Fields.Name: OnCancelActionID
Fields.Description: Action   invoked   when   a   task   of   this   type   transitions   to   Cancelled  ( post - commit ,  non - blocking ).

Fields.Name: Code
Fields.Description: Stable   unique   machine   code   for   programmatic   lookups   and   cross - app   metadata   references .

Fields.Name: OnCreateActionID
Fields.Description: Action   invoked   when   a   task   of   this   type   is   first   created  ( e . g .  kicks   off   a   task   graph   workflow ,  initialization   agent ,  or   subtask   template   generator ).

Fields.Name: OnStatusChangeActionID
Fields.Description: Action   invoked   whenever   a   task   of   this   type   changes   status .

Fields.Name: TaskTypeStatusID
Fields.Description: Optional   reference   to   the   dynamic   TaskTypeStatus   definition   for   tasks   with   type - specific   lifecycles .

Fields.Name: PredictedSLABreachProbability
Fields.Description: Predicted   probability  ( 0 . 0000  -  1 . 0000 )  that   this   task   breaches   its   target   due   date   or   SLA .

Fields.Name: PredictedSLARiskBand
Fields.Description: Operational   SLA   breach   risk   tier :  Low  (< 0 . 30 ),  Medium  ( 0 . 30 - 0 . 70 ),  High  (> 0 . 70 ),  or   Critical .

Fields.Name: PredictedSLAScoredAt
Fields.Description: Timestamp   when   this   task   was   last   scored   by   the   predictive   SLA   breach   model .
